title: MagicBeanStalk: Escaping the RLVR Zero Advantage Trap with Recursive Data Synthesis
data_curation: Math seeds come from a ~78K-problem open mixture (DAPO-Math-17K, Skywork-OR1-RL-Data, Turing Open-RL, a StackMathQA subset). Profiling with 8 gpt-oss-120b rollouts at 32K shows only 12.2% are 'Goldilocks' (1-7/8 correct); ~88% sit in the zero-advantage trap (mostly 8/8, 6.3% 0/8). Seeds are verified hard problems (0/8, all rollouts terminate normally) whose teacher traces are rejection-sampled from a pool (Gemini 3 Flash, Claude Opus 4.6, DeepSeek V4 Pro, GPT 5.2, Kimi K2.6). From ~1,250 0/8 seeds MBS yields 3,370 descendants (42.8% qualified, 74.7% seed conversion vs 43.8% for direct seed synthesis). Final filter: Goldilocks for the target policy plus in-budget solvability (>=1 correct rollout terminating within the budget). Finance: 340 expert questions on 17 credit agreements -> ~25K document-grounded candidates -> 14.2K Goldilocks problems; reward from a Qwen3-30B-A3B judge under a finance-aware rubric.
curriculum: Not a focus of this paper. Training is a single continual-RLVR stage on an already post-trained policy (gpt-oss-120b, DeepSeek v4 Flash, Qwen3-4B-Instruct) using the synthesized problems; the 'curriculum' is implicit in calibrating every retained problem to the target policy's Goldilocks band at the training budget. Early stopping halts training when a decline on a held-out synthetic subset is not recovered within 10 iterations.
method: MagicBeanStalk (MBS) is a top-down decomposition / bottom-up recursive synthesis algorithm. (1) Rejection-sample a verified teacher trace per hard seed. (2) The teacher decomposes it into K<=3 verified easier subproblems; an effectivity test keeps a decomposition only if conditioning a student on the solved children raises its parent accuracy (N=8, up to 3 retries, depth 3). (3) Bottom-up, the teacher writes explicitly harder leaf variants (dropped if weakest-student accuracy >0.8) and composes synthetic children into a parent mirroring the original structure (dropped if >0.625, up to 10 trials). Finance trees are re-grounded on 35-75 retrieved unseen documents. RL: GRPO via miles (Megatron-LM + SGLang); gpt-oss-120b uses LoRA rank 32, lr 4e-5, 32 prompts x 16 responses, 16K limit; DeepSeek v4 Flash uses full-model GRPO at lr 1e-6.
eval_metrics: Math: pass@1 at 16K on AIME 24/25, AMC, HMMT Feb/Nov, Minerva, Olympiad, Omega-500 (16 rollouts for gpt-oss-120b), answer checking via normalized strings, numeric equivalence and GPT-5.2 judge; also 8K-32K inference-budget sweeps and MathArena Apex-Shortlist (47 problems, 16 samples). Finance: pass@1/pass@5 on SecQue and FinanceBench (8 samples, T=1.0, 8K). Data analyses: GPT-5.6 blinded 1-5 scores for blueprint preservation and novelty (19.7% of MBS math pairs score >=4 on both vs 3.0% for seed synthesis; finance 86.0% vs 17.0%); three-judge quality audit (only 8.0% of math answers rejected by all three, 0% finance).
key_results: Continual RLVR on MBS data lifts gpt-oss-120b's 8-benchmark average from 61.2 to 69.8 (+8.6) versus +1.1 for the full 78K source mixture, +1.9 for Golden Goose and +5.8 for the best in-budget Goldilocks subset, and lifts DeepSeek v4 Flash from 72.4 to 77.9 with the same data; on MathArena Apex-Shortlist MBS gains +11.0/+13.3/+10.9 at 16K/24K/32K. In finance, 340 seeds yield 14K+ problems that improve Qwen3-4B-Instruct pass@1 by +6.9 on SecQue and +2.4 on FinanceBench.
evolution_note: MBS reacts to the zero-advantage problem that DAPO-style dynamic sampling only filters away, arguing that hard 0/8 problems are specifications of missing skills rather than waste. It extends teacher-written seed synthesis (CoT-Self-Instruct, SwS, PromptCoT) and Internet-mined task synthesis (Golden Goose, by overlapping authors) with policy- and budget-relative calibration and recursive decomposition. It is presented as complementary to algorithmic hard-problem methods (BroRL, POPE, hint/prefix guidance) and pushes RLVR scaling toward targeted, data-centric synthesis for strong frontier-scale policies and data-scarce domains like finance.
